scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && node scripts/configure-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:cloud:prepare: npm run build && rm -rf android && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:cloud:build: npm run android:cloud:prepare && chmod +x android/gradlew && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
